MATCH (tank:PlantItem {tag: "TK-1004"})-[:send_to]-(valve:PlantItem)<-[:control]-(actuator:PlantItem)<-[:send_signal_to]-(controller:ProcessControlFunction)
RETURN DISTINCT controller.loop_tag AS loop_tag

MATCH (item:PlantItem {tag: "T-5101"})-[:is_drawn_on]->(sheet:Sheet)
RETURN DISTINCT item.tag AS tag, sheet.sheet_id AS sheet_id
ORDER BY sheet_id

MATCH (s:PlantItem {tag: 'P-3001A'}), (t:PlantItem {tag: 'CHV-30005'})
MATCH p = shortestPath((s)-[:send_to*]->(t))
RETURN [n IN nodes(p)
        WHERE n:Equipment OR any(label IN labels(n) WHERE label IN [
          'AngleBallValve', 'AngleGlobeValve', 'AnglePlugValve', 'AngleValve',
          'BallValve', 'BreatherValve', 'ButterflyValve', 'CheckValve',
          'GateValve', 'GlobeCheckValve', 'GlobeValve', 'NeedleValve',
          'OperatedValve', 'PlugValve', 'SafetyValveOrFitting',
          'SpringLoadedAngleGlobeSafetyValve', 'SpringLoadedGlobeSafetyValve',
          'StraightwayValve', 'SwingCheckValve'
        ])
        | n.tag] AS path_tags

MATCH p = (upstream:PlantItem)-[:send_to*1..]->(pump:PlantItem {tag: "P-3701"})
UNWIND nodes(p) AS item
WITH DISTINCT item
WHERE any(label IN labels(item) WHERE label IN [
  "GateValve", "GlobeValve", "BallValve", "ButterflyValve", "PlugValve",
  "AngleValve", "AngleBallValve", "AngleGlobeValve", "AnglePlugValve",
  "NeedleValve"
])
RETURN item.tag AS tag
ORDER BY tag

MATCH (source:PlantItem {tag: 'P-5001C'})-[:send_to*1..]->(item:PlantItem)
WITH DISTINCT item
WHERE item.tag IS NOT NULL
  AND (item:Equipment OR any(label IN labels(item)
    WHERE label ENDS WITH 'Valve' OR label = 'SafetyValveOrFitting'))
RETURN item.tag AS tag,
       CASE WHEN item:Equipment THEN 'equipment' ELSE 'valve' END AS item_type
ORDER BY item_type, tag

MATCH (item:PlantItem {tag: "GTV-3011"})
RETURN item.tag AS tag, labels(item) AS item_type

MATCH (source:PlantItem)-[:send_to]->(destination:PlantItem)
WHERE toString(source.unit_id) = '23'
  AND destination.unit_id IS NOT NULL
  AND toString(destination.unit_id) <> '23'
RETURN DISTINCT destination.unit_id AS receiving_unit, destination.tag AS receiving_item_tag
ORDER BY receiving_unit, receiving_item_tag
